envelope.description: Implement canonical bytes and digest chain

body.title: Implement canonical bytes and digest chain
body.summary: Update canonical.ts to hash the complete validated manifest snapshot except the three cyclic digest slots; preserve canonical JSON, record identity and raw byte rules. Stage coverage path/mediaType before hashing, independently regenerate candidate/review/release vectors and update digest documentation.
acceptanceChecks: Key order and manifest inventory order do not affect identity; meaningful record-array order does.

recordVersion excludes recordVersion/review; candidate excludes only releaseId, reviewDigest and the unique coverage file digest. All other fields, including coverage path/mediaType, bind assessments; records/files sort by ID/version and path. Release hashes manifest without releaseId.
Invalid Unicode, non-JSON values, accessors, cycles, oversized input and non-finite/unsafe numbers are rejected before unbounded traversal or content hashing.
Zero/multiple coverage matches yield empty candidate identity; never omit all matches or choose arbitrarily. Tests cover every non-cyclic metadata field and all three exclusions.

tests.name: canonical.test.ts — independent byte/digest vectors and invalid JSON/limit boundaries
